title: A booking whose create-order answer was lost
caption: bookings.status and bookings.reconcile_outcome. The OTA worker reconciles until reconcile_until; what it cannot settle waits for staff in the Reconciliation review view, where the console's "Close the review" settles it (OBE-099).

states.label: pending (reconciling)
states.detail: Banner "Outcome unknown, reconciling until <time>"; Issue and Cancel hidden; in the **Reconciling** list.

states.label: pending + manual_review
states.detail: Banner "Reconciliation needs staff review"; **Close the review** for `bookings:cancel`; payment held, checkout locked; in the **Reconciliation review** view.

states.label: confirmed (found)
states.detail: `reconcile_outcome = found`, order recorded; Stripe authorisation captured then tickets per policy.

states.label: failed (not_found)
states.detail: `failure_code = SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT`; Stripe authorisation voided + `booking.not_confirmed`; airline card: payment `failed`, no e-mail.

transitions.label: reconcile_until passed, undecided (e.g. no booking queue)
Close the review: Order found + record locator with VELEXIS <reference>
Close the review: Not booked + note
refused: remark_mismatch, 412, card number in the note
